kps_sampling_caveat: Train order clusters submissions (often same problem_id). Not representative of random KPS; run_autonomous.sh now defaults SHUFFLE_SEED=42.

evaluation.description: Single-threaded gcc of generated .s, then up to 10 KPS tests per row; stdout written to a temp file (avoids PIPE deadlock on very chatty binaries). No hyperfine speedup. Identical-to-O0 assembly counts as correct without running tests.

notes: Official SuperCoder test_benchmark.py run (parallel + hyperfine) was OOM/SIGKILL in the automation environment on this 200-row run; simple_io_summary reflects the same compile+I/O semantics without speedup metrics.
Sequential docker gcc scan matched 193 compilable .s files.
